# o11y_alert_notification_group (Resource)

A bounded reusable group of alert contacts, provider destinations, or nested groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "o11y_alert_notification_group" "platform" {
  group_key = "platform-oncall"
  name      = "Platform on-call"
  enabled   = true

  members_json = jsonencode([
    {
      kind      = "contact"
      member_id = o11y_alert_contact.primary.id
      position  = 0
      enabled   = true
    }
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `group_key` (String)
- `members_json` (String) Ordered JSON array of {kind, member_id, position, enabled}; kind is contact, destination, or group.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)
